history.summary: A 3,346 sqft 4BR penthouse at The Seawind (FH, Far East-built, Telok Kurau D15) at $4.5M / $1,345 psf. This is an oversized penthouse — regular 4BR units there are ~2,000–2,265 sqft — so the low headline PSF reflects size, not value; the $4.5M absolute price sits in a thin, illiquid buyer band with no URA rate available.
history.rating_rationale: $4.5M quantum is well above the deep $1.8–2.5M pool; oversized PH at 3,346 sqft appeals to a tiny niche of buyers, and large penthouse sqft notoriously fails to command full per-sqft value on resale (the PSF discount is the market telling you). No URA appreciation/txn data for this unit type means no measurable growth case. Far East build quality is solid and FH/D15 are fine, but as a 5–7yr investment the exit risk and capital lock-up are disqualifying.
red_flags: $4.5M quantum far outside the liquid band — very shallow buyer pool
3,346 sqft oversized penthouse — PSF masks weak per-sqft resale value
No URA appreciation or transaction data for this unit type
Penthouses in boutique D15 blocks turn over slowly
catalysts: Freehold, Far East build quality, D15 East Coast lifestyle
